preview.headline: Toronto starts on top, and it is not close
preview.dek: The auction is over, nobody has played a game, and we already have opinions. Here is how the ten teams stack up before opening night.

teams.text: Toronto treated the auction like a grocery run with somebody else's card. Luka Dončić cost $25M, and the Jays still walked out with Scottie Barnes, Cade Cunningham and Karl-Anthony Towns. Every starter is signed through at least 2030. The bench has Tyrese Haliburton, Donovan Mitchell and a 39-year-old Kevin Durant on $4M, which is unfair. The only open question is who gets the ball, and that is a lovely question to have.

The Gooners signed Nikola Jokić and Alperen Şengün, two centers who both want the ball at the elbow, and decided to sort it out later. Anthony Edwards and Tyrese Maxey supply the scoring, Giannis Antetokounmpo arrived for $6M, and the whole starting five cost $48M. The other $37M bought a bench that is mostly promise: three guards aged 21 or younger. If the kids hold up, this is the one team that can take a series off Toronto.

Cambridge led the auction for most of the weekend, then watched Dončić and Jokić get bid away on the final day. What is left is still good: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander at $21M, Jayson Tatum, Jalen Brunson and Chet Holmgren, plus Stephen Curry, who is 39 and costs $5M. The Platypuses finished with $29M unspent, the most in the league, which is either discipline or a missed bid depending on who you ask. A playoff team with a guard for every occasion.

Waltham spent a third of its budget on one player, and it is hard to argue. Victor Wembanyama's $33M is the richest deal in the league by $8M. The Bears then signed Josh Giddey for $1M five seconds before the deadline, the best piece of business all weekend. Cooper Flagg, Amen Thompson and Jalen Johnson make this the most athletic frontcourt going. Whether a 23-year-old center and a 21-year-old forward can drag a team into the top four is the season's best subplot.

The Stingrays have Evan Mobley, Bam Adebayo and Jaren Jackson Jr., so good luck scoring at the rim. Scoring at the other end is the worry: the offence runs through Kawhi Leonard, who is 36, and Quentin Grimes. Stony Brook is the best bet among the bottom six to crash the top four, mostly because somebody has to be. Expect a lot of games that finish 98-94.

Durham's starting small forward is LeBron James, who is 43. He is on a one-year deal, which feels right. The actual plan is on the wings, where Trey Murphy III and Deni Avdija cost $13M each, and at point guard, where Ja Morant and a 37-year-old Damian Lillard will take turns. Cameron Boozer, 20, is the rookie to watch. There are 23 years between the oldest and youngest Destroyers, and you may well see both on the floor at once.

The oldest roster in the league already has its first casualty: Jimmy Butler, 38, will miss 35 of the 36 games. The Thunder's richest contract belongs to VJ Edgecombe, who is 22 and makes $12M, twice what Devin Booker does. James Harden is also 38 and also here. There is real talent in Booker, Zion Williamson and Domantas Sabonis, and a real chance most of it is on the injury report by Game 10.

Nashville's second-biggest contract, Moses Moody at $9M, is out for 35 games, so the Elephants open the season with $9M sitting in a suit. What remains is guards: Jalen Suggs, Jamal Murray, Tyler Herro, Immanuel Quickley and Luguentz Dort, all of whom would like the same minutes. Rudy Gobert, 35, and Myles Turner guard the rim. It is a perfectly professional team with no obvious way to win a shootout.

Franz Wagner at $18M is the fourth-richest deal in the league, and the Dragons will need every dollar of it. Anthony Davis is 34 and on a one-year contract, and Pascal Siakam and Fred VanVleet are both 33. Trae Young comes off the bench for $5M, behind a starting five with no point guard in it. Jalen Williams is the piece worth watching. Everything else here has a best-before date.

Somebody has to be last. Queens has Austin Reaves on $13M, De'Aaron Fox, Derrick White and Brandon Ingram, which reads like a decent team until you notice that everyone above them has a star and the Pigeons have four second options. Neemias Queta and Sandro Mamukelashvili are the centers at $6M each. The upside: Stephon Castle is 23 and signed through 2031, and the first pick in the 2027 draft is very much in play.

1.headline: Last-ranked Queens flattens Stony Brook on opening night
1.dek: Austin Reaves scored 38, Jayson Tatum missed three shots all night, and Toronto won by 34 as the favourites and one very loud underdog opened 1-0.

games.text: The preseason rankings had Queens tenth out of ten. Austin Reaves read them. He took 26 shots, 18 of them 3-pointers, made seven and finished with 38 points and eight assists as the Pigeons flattened Stony Brook 128-103. Queens scored 46 in the second quarter and led by 34. Tobias Harris made all five of his shots, four from deep, then strained his groin. Kawhi Leonard went 1-for-8 from three for the Stingrays, who open as the 9 seed. Queens is the 2 seed, which nobody had on the card.

Jayson Tatum took 16 shots and made 13. He took eight 3-pointers and made seven. He finished with 38 points, 10 rebounds and eight assists, and Cambridge buried Rochester 143-123 after leading 79-58 at halftime. Stephen Curry, who is 39, added 24. Rochester's leading scorer was Trae Young, off the bench, with 16 points and nine assists, and Franz Wagner left with a strained hamstring. The Platypuses are the 4 seed. The Dragons are the 7 seed and already short a star.

Toronto was the heavy favourite and behaved like it. Cade Cunningham scored 35, Luka Dončić had 25 with seven rebounds and six assists, Karl-Anthony Towns went 8-for-11 for 20 points and 12 rebounds, and the Jays ran Ithaca off its own floor, 145-111. It was 69-62 at halftime. Then Toronto won the third quarter 36-22 and the game stopped being one. Ithaca got exactly 19 points from three different players, which is tidy and not enough. The Jays are the 1 seed. The Thunder are the 10 seed.

The two-center experiment survived its first night. Nikola Jokić made 12 of 16 shots for 31 points, nine rebounds and eight assists, Anthony Edwards missed once in nine tries for 24, and the Gooners beat Waltham 142-121. The Bears trailed by only five after three quarters, then lost the fourth 35-19. Victor Wembanyama scored 26 but went 3-for-11 from deep. Josh Giddey, the $1M signing, made seven of his eight shots. The Gooners are the 3 seed. Waltham opens as the 8 seed.

LeBron James is 43 and needed 20 shots to score 24, and Durham won anyway, 121-109 at Nashville. Damian Lillard, 37, scored 26 on 12 shots, and Trey Murphy III added 20. The bill arrived late: Ja Morant fractured his nose and will miss the next three games. Nashville got 24 points and nine assists from Jamal Murray and 7-for-20 shooting from Tyler Herro, and trailed by 19 at one point. Durham is the 5 seed, a tiebreak out of the top four. Nashville is the 6 seed.

2.headline: Young deals 19 assists as Rochester flattens Queens
2.dek: Toronto, the Gooners and Cambridge all moved to 2-0, LeBron James scored 33 at age 43 and lost, and Ithaca is still looking for a win.

games.text: Rochester lost its $18M forward to a hamstring on opening night and responded by putting Trae Young in the starting five, which turned out to be a good idea. Young took seven shots, made six and handed out 19 assists as the Dragons flattened Queens 126-104. Pascal Siakam cashed most of them, going 10-for-13 for 25 points and 12 rebounds. Austin Reaves, a 38-point scorer one game ago, shot 6-for-18. Rochester won the second half 67-47 and climbs to the 6 seed. Queens drops from the 2 seed to the 5 seed.

LeBron James is 43. He scored 33 on 14-for-22 shooting with seven assists, and Durham lost to Cambridge anyway, 123-117, because Ja Morant was watching with a fractured nose. Jayson Tatum finished one assist short of a triple-double on a 7-for-18 night, Jalen Brunson missed 10 of his 11 3-pointers, and Paul George, who is 37, came off the bench to make eight of 11 shots for 22. Cambridge is 2-0 and the 3 seed. Durham keeps the 4 seed at 1-1, for now.

Nashville led Toronto by nine in the first half, which will be a nice thing to remember. The Jays won the third quarter 32-17 and the game 116-95. Scottie Barnes made 12 of 17 shots for 25 points, nine rebounds and seven assists. Luka Dončić shot 9-for-25, missed nine of his 10 3-pointers and still finished with 21 points, 11 rebounds and eight assists. Jamal Murray went 0-for-5 from deep for the Elephants, who are 0-2 and the 8 seed. Toronto is 2-0 and the 1 seed.

Nikola Jokić had 25 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists on 15 shots, Alperen Şengün added 14 and 10, and the Gooners beat Stony Brook 124-109 without ever trailing by more than two. Anthony Edwards missed all five of his 3-pointers and it did not matter. Kawhi Leonard scored 22 for the Stingrays, a team built around three elite big men that has now allowed 252 points in two games. The Gooners are 2-0 and the 2 seed. Stony Brook is 0-2 and the 9 seed.

Waltham has its first win, 118-111 over Ithaca, and its best player was the one who cost $1M. Josh Giddey made five of six 3-pointers for 23 points and seven assists. Victor Wembanyama shot 5-for-18 and missed seven of eight from deep, then made up for it with 15 rebounds. Ithaca got 27 from Zion Williamson on 10-for-12 shooting and six 3-pointers in seven tries from OG Anunoby, and lost. The Bears are the 7 seed. The Thunder are 0-2 and still the 10 seed.

3.headline: Cambridge is the last unbeaten after holding off Toronto
3.dek: Rochester stunned the Gooners by a point, Waltham survived Stony Brook by one, and LeBron James, 43, posted a triple-double.

games.text: Cambridge never trailed, led by 21 and then spent the fourth quarter watching Toronto chew through the lead before winning 115-109. Jalen Brunson ran it with 26 points and 12 assists, and Paul George, 37 and filling in for the injured Stephen Curry, had 22 points and 10 rebounds. Jayson Tatum missed eight of nine 3-pointers and it did not matter. Luka Dončić needed 28 shots for his 30, with Cade Cunningham out. The Platypuses are 3-0 and the 1 seed. Toronto slips to the 2 seed.

Franz Wagner came back from a hamstring strain and scored 34, and Rochester beat the Gooners 126-125 in their building. The Dragons scored 45 in the second quarter and led by 10 after three, then held on as the lead melted to one. Anthony Edwards made eight of 11 3-pointers for 32, and Nikola Jokić had 23 points, 10 rebounds and 18 assists in a loss, which takes some doing. The Gooners were without Giannis Antetokounmpo and fall to the 3 seed. Rochester is the 5 seed at 2-1.

Victor Wembanyama had 30 points and 18 rebounds, missed all five of his 3-pointers, and Waltham beat Stony Brook 103-102. Evan Mobley took 24 shots for the Stingrays and made eight. Jaren Jackson Jr. took nine and made eight, so the shots went to the wrong man. Stony Brook played without Bam Adebayo and is 0-3, now the 10 seed. The Bears have won two straight and are the 6 seed.

LeBron James is still 43. He had 19 points, 12 rebounds and 11 assists, and Durham won 120-113 at Queens after trailing by four entering the fourth quarter, which the Destroyers took 36-25. Trey Murphy III scored 25 and Deni Avdija 21. Austin Reaves had 28 points and 13 assists for the Pigeons on 22 shots. Durham holds the 4 seed at 2-1. Queens has lost two straight and drops to the 7 seed.

Nashville scored 49 points in the second quarter, led by 16, and lost. Ithaca won the fourth quarter 36-19 and the game 124-117 for its first win of the season. Domantas Sabonis scored 22 on 11 shots and Devin Booker handed out 12 assists. Jamal Murray had 31 and Jalen Suggs 29 for the Elephants, and Tyler Herro went 1-for-10 from three. Ithaca climbs to the 8 seed. Nashville is 0-3 and the 9 seed.

4.headline: LeBron scores 37 as Durham erases a 24-point hole
4.dek: Cambridge lost its unbeaten record at winless Nashville, Waltham won a third straight, and Stony Brook finally won a game, in overtime.

games.text: The Gooners led Durham 75-53 at halftime and by 24 at their peak. Then LeBron James, who is 43, decided the evening was not over. He scored 37 on 15-for-23 shooting, Durham won the second half 73-49 and the game 126-124. Nikola Jokić finished with 17 points, 17 rebounds and 18 assists and shot 6-for-20, a stat line with something for everyone. Tyrese Maxey scored 29 on 12 shots in the loss. Durham is 3-1 and the 3 seed. The Gooners have lost two straight and drop to the 5 seed.

The last unbeaten team went to the last winless one and lost. Nashville beat Cambridge 122-117 behind 31 points from Jamal Murray, who needed 27 shots, and six 3-pointers in eight tries from Tyler Herro. Joel Embiid, the $1M center, came off the bench for 21 on 8-for-11 shooting, and it was not enough with Stephen Curry still out. There were 12 lead changes. The Platypuses slip to the 2 seed at 3-1. The Elephants are 1-3 and the 9 seed, and will take it.

Waltham never trailed, led by 22 and then made its fans sit through a 36-24 fourth quarter before winning 114-110 at Rochester. Victor Wembanyama had 32 points, 18 rebounds and seven assists. Josh Giddey, still on $1M, added 21 points and 10 assists. Pascal Siakam scored 27 for the Dragons and Franz Wagner 22. The Bears have won three straight and jump from the 6 seed to the 4 seed. Rochester is 2-2 and the 6 seed.

Toronto led Queens by 23, scored 20 points in the fourth quarter and escaped 127-123. Luka Dončić made six of nine 3-pointers for 29 points and eight assists. Scottie Barnes missed all six of his. Austin Reaves scored 38 for the second time in four games, and the Pigeons have lost three in a row anyway. The Jays are back in the 1 seed at 3-1. Queens is the 7 seed at 1-3.

Stony Brook has a win, and it only took four games and an overtime. The Stingrays led Ithaca by 17, gave up 35 points in the fourth quarter to let it get to an extra period, then won that 19-12 for a 132-125 final. Evan Mobley finished an assist short of a triple-double with 20 points and 11 rebounds, and Quentin Grimes scored 23. Devin Booker had 29 for the Thunder. Stony Brook climbs to the 8 seed. Ithaca is the 10 seed again.
